title: World Championship Decks 2002: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "First through the Riftstone was Genesis—and the world was lifeless no more." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
"Glory was gone; Glory was everywhere." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
He wished for growth, but not for a way to control it.
"How could someone so small cause so much trouble?" —Nomad sentry
It's so tough it can frighten *itself* into hiding.
"The earth shook, the sky rained fire, and it seemed the world was ending." —Benalish refugee
A fool knows no fear. A hero shows no fear.
Llanowar covers a million square miles, yet nobody enters the forest without the elves knowing it.
"Fear this no more!"
The calm comes after the storm.
"Change your mind, or I'll change it for you."
"Anyone can snap her fingers and yank a soul. I prefer to kill creatively." —Braids, dementia summoner
Anything sent into a plagued world is bound to come back infected.
Murky Otarian tides hide the forgotten treacheries of the Phyrexian war.
Only death breeds in stagnant water. —Urborg saying
He wished for knowledge, but not for the will to apply it.
Nightscape masters don't stop at raising the spirit of a fallen battlemage. They raise the flesh along with it.
The elves had the edge in guile, skill, and valor. But in the end, only sheer numbers mattered.
The pits have their own form of mercy.
The deep sleep of winter is not always restful.
"Remove their power, and their will to fight will follow." —Tolarian wizard
"Eri phar phesta … um, phistor … er, phistara …"
A fruit must rot before its seed can sprout. —Yavimaya saying
Faster than a cobra's bite.
The ideas came flooding in so fast that they couldn't all be contained.
He exercises his right to bear arms.
Some minds are more open than others.
Teferi wanted no part of Urza's battle plans, but both agreed the Phyrexian portal must be closed.
"The awestruck birds gazed at Wonder. Slowly, timidly, they rose into the air." —*Scroll of Beginnings*
Books are like crops—they must be thinned for best yield.
"You aren't invited."
Webs of illusion unravel in the light of truth.
"I'd be happy to stop contradicting you, Urza, just as soon as you start being right." —Bo Levar, planeswalker
Hot wind whipped up as if the weather itself wanted to fight Phyrexians.
In the Krosan Forest, you've got to keep an eye out for the squirrels.
It teaches *you* to play dead.
"The specimen seems to be broken."
"The best foresight is hindsight." —Empress Llawan
"For dim-witted, thick-skulled genetic mutants, they have pretty good aim." —Sisay
When you sink a lot of ships, it's easy to find sunken treasure.
Exhausting a wizard can be exhausting work.
